description: This file defines the Identifier model class for OpenCart's admin localisation module. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve, and count identifier records in the database, including handling caching and filtering.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: Model class for managing identifier records in the database within the localisation module.

methods.name: addIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a new identifier record in the database and returns its primary key.

methods.name: editIdentifier
methods.description: Updates an existing identifier record in the database based on identifier ID.

methods.name: deleteIdentifier
methods.description: Deletes an identifier record from the database by identifier ID.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a specific identifier record by ID.

methods.name: getIdentifierByCode
methods.description: Fetches a single identifier record based on its unique code.

methods.name: getIdentifiers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of identifier records with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalIdentifiers
methods.description: Returns the total number of identifier records in the database.
